title: Feasibility of biofuel production from crop stubble/straw in Australia: challenges and opportunities
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00864F, Review Article
M. A. Sattar, M. A. Hosen, M. Johnstone
In Australia, corn stover, wheat straw, and sugarcane bagasse can be used as feedstocks for biofuel production using mature technologies but require stronger policy support, industrial uptake, and environmental management.
